subject: LumenAI — procurement & marketplace follow-up
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T15:23:00Z
Subject: LumenAI — procurement & marketplace follow-up

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the call today — appreciate you walking us through LumenAI's deployment plans. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

What we heard
- You're targeting a mid-July production launch for the first integration with customer-facing features.
- Procurement stance: prefer AWS Marketplace for ease of procurement but finance will accept a PO for annual contracts if needed.
- Card payment possible for POC spend under ~$5k.
- Legal wants a standard DPA + SOC2 evidence; they'll start review this week and expect ~2 weeks.

Open questions we flagged
- Final annual committed spend range (ballpark) so we can recommend an optimal SKU/discount structure.
- Marketplace: do you need us to operate under an AWS Marketplace listing or will you purchase via credit card/direct invoice?

Next steps (owners)
- Camila (me): send pricing worksheet and AWS Marketplace procurement guide + marketplace listing link (attached).
- Alex: share procurement contact and PO template if you want us to quote on a PO.
- Marissa: (cc) ready to prepare a formal quote and contract once we confirm purchase path and term.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-2026Q2.xlsx (pricing + two SKUs), redwood-marketplace-guide-1pager.pdf (procurement flow)

If that looks right I'll follow up with a mutual action plan and suggest times for a short procurement sync next week.

Thanks — talk soon,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@lumenai.com>
Date: 2026-06-13T10:01:00Z
Subject: Re: LumenAI — procurement & marketplace follow-up

Thanks Camila — great summary. A few clarifications from procurement/finance side:

- Marketplace preference: AWS Marketplace preferred for production purchases because it flows through our AWS billing and security team is already set up there.
- PO vs card: For any annual commitment we use a PO (Finance issues a PO that gets sent to vendor). For a quick POC we can use a corporate card up to ~$5k as you noted.
- Timeline: procurement + legal review will be ~3-6 weeks depending on redlines; budget is already provisioned for July start.
- Contact: attaching our PO template for your quoting. Procurement lead is Maya Patel (copied).

Attachment: LumenAI_PO_template.pdf

Could you also confirm whether Redwood supports consolidated invoicing if we buy via AWS Marketplace or if you require billing to happen through Redwood directly? That will impact the procurement flow.

Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships | LumenAI
alex.chen@lumenai.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: LumenAI — procurement & marketplace follow-up

Appreciate the quick response, Alex. Helpful detail — below are clarifications and proposed next steps: 

Marketplace / billing
- We support purchases via AWS Marketplace (Metered or Private Offers) and can do consolidated invoicing through AWS billing if you buy via Marketplace.
- If you prefer a direct PO to Redwood (outside of Marketplace) we can accept a PO and invoice on net-30 / net-45 depending on contract terms — we'll note that on the quote.

Legal & procurement docs
- We'll share a DPA and SOC 2 summary now; full SOC 2 report available under NDA (I'll include the link).

Action items (mutual action plan)
- Camila/Marissa: prepare two paths for you: 1) AWS Marketplace private offer flow with estimated consumption-based unit economics, 2) Direct PO quote with annual commit pricing and invoice terms. Deliverable by EOD Tue (2026-06-16).
- Alex/Maya: confirm the procurement sync time — we're proposing Tue 2026-06-16 10:00am PT or Wed 2026-06-17 11:00am PT.

Related links: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/listing/redwood-inference (example listing), https://redwood.ai/marketplace-procurement-guide

I'll attach the DPA and pricing sheet. Marissa will draft the PO quote once you confirm preferred path.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: LumenAI PO template / procurement questions

Forwarding the PO template and a few procurement notes —

Hi Camila / Marissa,

We reviewed the options internally and would like the formal quote to include both purchase paths:
1) AWS Marketplace private offer (to flow through our AWS invoicing)
2) Direct PO to Redwood with annual commit pricing and standard net-30 invoicing

Two quick questions for the quote:
- Does Redwood offer consolidated invoicing and cost-center breakdowns if we buy via Marketplace? We need usage broken out by AWS account.
- If we go direct PO, what are your standard invoice terms and do you support vendor onboarding via our procurement portal?

Attaching the PO template. Please provide an itemized quote + reference PO number field we can drop into our system. If possible, include a sample private offer ID for AWS so our procurement team can see the end-to-end flow.

Attachment: LumenAI_PO_template.pdf

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Procurement Manager | LumenAI
